description: Covers the red tests compiler2_runtime_demand_marks_an_escaped_callable_first_class, compiler2_runtime_demand_marks_callable_arguments_to_opaque_calls_first_class, compiler2_transport_plan_publishes_boundary_returns_per_surface, and compiler2_abi_ready_callable_entries_read_boundary_seam_facts. Likely root cause: runtime demand/transport is conflating direct call surfaces, first-class publication surfaces, and canonical resolutions, causing escaped callables to retain direct surfaces and ABI-ready inventory to duplicate boundary entries across resolutions/surfaces. Fix the single upstream model so first-class publication facts are distinct from direct-use facts and ABI reads the resulting BoundaryId facts exactly once. No downstream de-dup adapter or type-derived boundary selection.
title: Artifact seam: separate first-class callable publication from direct surfaces
